_about: Public-domain Thomas Rattray (1684-1743), Bishop of Brechin and then Primus of the Scottish Episcopal Church, the liturgist of the Scottish Communion Office, for the Word Hoard: The Ancient Liturgy of the Church of Jerusalem, being the Liturgy of St. James (London, 1744), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 41 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
